question: Can the selective MoSE residual and the simplified one-slot exchange compose into a material K1 improvement?

hypothesis.observed_deficiency: K1 retains topology-extreme errors; selective MoSE and slot simplification each improved the aligned development role but remained below the material gate alone.
alternative_explanations: the two directional gains may be non-additive
the apparent gains may reflect cross-runtime optimization-trajectory diversity rather than the changed mechanisms
hypothesis.changed_mechanism: add a zero-initialized selective MoSE residual while deleting length-one slot self-attention and using uniform normalized slot return
hypothesis.cheapest_falsifier: one fixed V5 PCQM-100K seed-42 screen against the immutable aligned K1 prediction reference
hypothesis.decision_changed_if_positive: permit one separately authorized 500K transfer and native-cost decision
hypothesis.decision_changed_if_negative: close structural-residual plus slot-simplification composition without another seed or scale-up

reopen_conditions: an explicit contract amendment permits chained sub-threshold mechanisms and new evidence changes the single-mechanism decision

comparison_blockers: the proposal is not released because it chains two sub-threshold mechanisms under a single-mechanism funnel
